title: What happened in AI — Oct 14, 2026
intro: Agent builders got practical patterns today: context engineering for long-running agents, a code review agent design, and 10,000-agent runs lasting 36+ hours.

Underneath, serving and spend controls are maturing, with vLLM's push-based KV transfer and BigQuery's cost management for AI functions, while Antigravity's local-model support pushes agents onto developer machines.
highlights: LangChain: offloading, summarization, skills, subagents, and memory keep long-running agent context focused.
Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours on GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
vLLM adds a push-based NIXL connector that writes KV straight into decode memory over RDMA.
BigQuery adds cost management for AI.GENERATE, AI.IF, AI.CLASSIFY, and AI.SCORE.
Google's Antigravity SDK adds local model support.
Meta extends Private Processing to AI glasses with confidential VMs and remote attestation.
